national_raw_news.content: The Union Cabinet has approved the continuation of Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana for a period of five years upto 31st March 2031. As of September this year, more than 60.36 crore loans amounting to 43.34 lakhs crore rupees have been sanctioned by lending institutions since launch of PM Mudra Scheme. Briefing media in New Delhi today after the Union Cabinet meeting, Information and Broadcasting Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said that the outlay of five thousand crore rupees is approved for guarantee and it is expected to support mudra loans worth 12.60 lakh crore rupees. The Union Cabinet has approved the continuation of Stand-Up India Scheme for a period of five years upto 31st March 2031. The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship among Women, Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes and aims to provide financial assistance to additional 2.5 lakh entrepreneurs in a span of five years. Since its launch in April 2016, the scheme has facilitated loans to more than 2.75 lakh Women, SC, and ST entrepreneurs. Mr Vaishnaw said that the scheme guarantees loans of ten lakh to one crore rupees to women, SC and ST entrepreneurs. He said, the scheme duration will be for four years, with a Corpus of four thousand 111 crore rupees towards credit guarantee. The Union Cabinet has approved the extension of Aqua Line Metro Rail Corridor from Noida Sector-51 to Greater Noida Sector-04 of Noida Metro Rail Project covering approximately 8.5 kilometres and comprising five elevated stations. On operationalisation of this corridor, Noida and Greater Noida will have around 72 kilometres of active Metro Rail Network. The extension of the Aqua Line Metro Rail Corridor represents a significant advancement in the city’s infrastructure development.

national_raw_news.title: Russia and Ukraine agree in principle on major prisoner-of-war exchange after US-mediated talks i...
national_raw_news.content: Russia and Ukraine have agreed in principle to a major prisoner-of-war exchange following two days of US-mediated negotiations in Abu Dhabi, although no breakthrough was reached on ending the nearly five-year conflict. US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner described the talks as difficult but productive. Kushner said the agreement could lead to the biggest humanitarian release of prisoners since the war began, with final numbers expected to be confirmed shortly. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy welcomed the progress but insisted that European countries must be involved in negotiations concerning the continent’s security. Kyiv wants future discussions to move beyond the existing trilateral format involving Russia, Ukraine and the US. Washington has indicated support for European participation, particularly on security guarantees, while Moscow has questioned the need for European representatives in direct negotiations, arguing that their support for Ukraine makes them unsuitable as neutral participants. Kushner and Witkoff are expected to travel to Moscow to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday before travelling to Dublin to brief Zelenskyy on the discussions. Separately, reports indicated that Putin had expressed openness to contacts with European leaders, including German Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Berlin, however, has reiterated that Europe must have a say in any settlement affecting its security, stressing that decisions on Europe’s future security order cannot be made without European participation. Despite the prisoner-swap understanding, major differences remain over territory, security guarantees and Ukraine’s future relationship with NATO.

national_raw_news.content: President Droupadi Murmu will confer Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025-26 at a ceremony in New Delhi today. These awards honour India’s cleanest cities, celebrating their outstanding contributions to Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban. Housing and Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal, and Minister of State of the Ministry, Tokhan Sahu will be present on the occasion. The Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 awards serve as a celebration of the collective achievements of cities and States and a renewed commitment to sustain on-ground achievements. The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs informed that the 10th edition of the Swachh Survekshan on the theme of ‘Swachhata Ki Nayi Pehel- Badhayein Haath, Karein Safai Saath’ has been completed. It said that Swachh Survekshan has grown from 73 Urban Local Bodies in 2016 to more than four thousand cities in its latest edition. Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 introduced several key enhancements, including greater emphasis on citizen feedback, expanded coverage of Urban River Fronts, and focused indicators on prevention of open defecation and open urination and behaviour change initiatives in schools. As part of the 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan, Urban Local Bodies were evaluated across 43 indicators spanning 10 key assessment areas. These include segregation, collection and transportation of waste, solid waste management, access to sanitation, overall welfare of sanitation workers and citizen feedback and grievance redressal.

national_raw_news.title: Northern Railway to run 31 special trains from major stations in the Delhi area today in view of ...
national_raw_news.content: In view of the Chhath festival, Northern Railway will operate 31 special trains from major railway stations in the Delhi region from today. The move is aimed at facilitating passengers travelling to their native places to celebrate the festival, particularly those heading towards eastern parts of the country. The Railways operated 27 special trains from major stations in the Delhi region yesterday. The Railways is also keeping a close watch on passenger movement and will operate additional special trains, as required. Senior railway officials are monitoring the situation at major railway stations. Meanwhile, preparations are in full swing at various Chhath ghats across Delhi. Elaborate arrangements are being made at more than 1400 Chhath ghats across Delhi this year. Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta reviewed the preparations for Chhath Puja. She also directed concerned departments to ensure proper facilities for devotees. An 11-kilometre-long Chhath Ghat has been developed along the Munak Canal, stretching from the Outer Ring Road to Inderlok. BJP National President Nitin Nabin will inaugurate the grand Ghat tomorrow. Additionally, the Delhi Government also declared a public holiday on 16th of this month on account of Chhath Puja. Schools, colleges, government offices, autonomous bodies and public sector undertakings under the Delhi Government will remain closed on the day.

national_raw_news.title: Government invites fresh applications under PLI scheme for medical devices
national_raw_news.content: The Government has invited fresh applications under the Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Promoting Domestic Manufacturing of Medical Devices, known as PLI-MD 2.0. The scheme has been extended up to 2035-36, with a total outlay of around two thousand seven hundred crore rupees. The online application portal is expected to become operational within the next ten days. The Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers said several changes have been introduced in the scheme based on the experience gained during its first phase. These include simplified eligibility conditions and an easier procedure for claiming incentives. Under the revised scheme, applicants will get three years to establish manufacturing facilities in any of the four target segments. These include medical consumables, disposables and implants; critical components; high-end medical devices with limited domestic manufacturing; and high-end devices that are currently only assembled in the country. The government has also removed the minimum sales threshold for claiming incentives and reduced the minimum investment requirement. To improve ease of doing business, companies can submit multiple applications across one or more target segments. The application window will also remain open continuously for an extended period. The initiative aims to strengthen domestic manufacturing of medical devices and promote investment in the sector.
